title: Pasta with Tomato-Based Sauce and Added Vegetables, Ready-to-Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with tomato-based sauce and added vegetables is a ready‑to‑heat meal containing durum wheat pasta, a sauce made from ripe tomatoes, carrots, zucchini, sweet pepper and green peas. The product is pre‑cooked, so it only needs to be heated in a microwave or on the stove.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The tomato sauce is prepared from ripe tomatoes, which are rich in lycopene – a powerful antioxidant.
Vegetables are added after a short blanching to preserve their bright colour and some vitamins.
The pasta is usually made from durum wheat, giving it a firm texture and lower glycemic impact.
The dish can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 5 days or frozen for up to 3 months.
Heat to at least 75 °C to ensure complete microbial safety.

items.title: Rich in lycopene
items.content: Tomatoes in the sauce provide lycopene, which supports heart health and may reduce the risk of certain cancers.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Durum wheat pasta supplies vitamin B1 (thiamine) and vitamin B3 (niacin), important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Fiber from vegetables
items.content: Carrots, zucchini and peas increase dietary fiber, promoting healthy digestion.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The meal contains potassium, magnesium and iron, essential for electrolyte balance and blood formation.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Prepared without added butter, the dish has minimal saturated fat content.

items.title: Gluten content
items.content: Durum wheat pasta contains gluten, making the product unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sodium
items.content: The tomato sauce may contain added salt; those monitoring sodium intake should account for it.

items.title: Tomato allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to tomatoes or other vegetables in the mix.

items.title: Improper heating
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave the product vulnerable to microbial growth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in the microwave for about 2–3 minutes, stirring halfway, or warm it on the stove until steam rises. Serve immediately; optional toppings include grated Parmesan or fresh herbs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 0–4 °C in the original packaging for up to 5 days. For longer storage, freeze in an airtight container for up to 3 months. If frozen, ensure the product is fully thawed before reheating.
